name: Super Monkey Ball Deluxe (US Xbox), smbd-recompilation

identity.note: SHA-256 of the US default.xbe; the recompiler writes it on the first line of every generated shard.

extra_sources.note: CMakeLists.txt globs game.cpp.[0-9][0-9][0-9].cpp into smbd-cpu; stock shards stop at 511.

build_note: Do not use tools/Build.ps1 -Stage Game here: it regenerates every shard with --replace. Run `osmod restore` before Build.ps1, and `osmod build` again after it.

host.note: src/osmod_host.{h,cpp}: the OSMod reference host. Mods page in Settings, per-mod switches in data/local/osmod.cfg, disc redirects and replacement files.
